scope: Backend unit and integration tests against a newly created isolated PostgreSQL test database on 127.0.0.1:55433
runnerNotes: The first restricted attempt exited 1 with only 'Test runner failed.' and no Jest results; the required escalated rerun completed successfully.
Three migrations applied in the temporary test database: initial, constraints, login_captcha.
The runner deletes its generated test database and upload directory in finally and stops the isolated test PostgreSQL server.
No application source changes or frontend test execution were performed.

observations: Foreign-Origin refresh and logout return 403; configured loopback aliases succeed.
Refresh token reuse returns 401 and invalidates the rotated access token family.
Logout returns 200; replay of the previously valid access token at /api/auth/me returns 401.
Two concurrent password resets with one token return 200 and 400; the old access token returns 401.
Disabling an account invalidates its existing access token.
The third failed login returns a CAPTCHA image; direct API login without the required CAPTCHA returns 401/CAPTCHA_REQUIRED with no cookie.
Wrong, expired, or reused CAPTCHA responses fail.
A valid challenge permits login with status 200 and clears the failure counter.
Parallel failed login attempts are counted; expired lockout state is cleared.
Unauthenticated /api/admin/users returns 401; USER access returns 403; ADMIN access returns 200.
Registration with role=ADMIN returns 400; ordinary registration creates a USER and private cart.
Profile mass-assignment role=ADMIN returns 400 and the stored role remains USER.
Cross-user review update/delete, cart-item update, order access, ticket access, and attachment download are denied with 404.
The ticket owner and administrator can download the attachment; its backing private asset is not publicly retrievable.
Product search with SQL metacharacters returns 200 and zero matches; excessive pagination is rejected with 400.
Negative and fractional cart quantities are rejected with 400.
A disguised SVG upload named as PNG is rejected; a decoded PNG succeeds.
Image import rejects an unapproved origin, a redirect, and an oversized response; an approved valid image succeeds.
rubricMapping.limits: The SQL metacharacter test targets product search only; it is not a direct SQL injection test of the login endpoint.

observations: Client-supplied order total is rejected; server total calculation, idempotent checkout, single-order concurrency, and stock protection pass.
Concurrent coupon usage respects maxUses; invalid order transitions are rejected.
Integer money calculation and terminal order state tests pass.
rubricMapping.limits: These are additional commerce-business-logic checks; they do not replace analysis of each authentication abuse scenario required by A8.

observations: Test fixtures obtain access tokens through real application login handlers.
Successful and failed authentication behavior is exercised at the HTTP application interface.
rubricMapping.limits: Supertest exercises the Express application in-process; this is not a browser end-to-end, reverse-proxy, TLS, or public deployment test.

importantCoverageLimits: 27/27 passing is evidence for these assertions, not proof that the whole application is free of vulnerabilities.

The review test named 'persists plain text' submits hello and verifies creation/ownership statuses, but does not assert the saved content or browser rendering. Do not cite it as proof of frontend XSS escaping.
The coupon test name mentions non-reuse after cancellation but its assertions only test concurrent maximum-use enforcement. Do not overstate cancellation coverage.
No real login request screenshot, user database screenshot, frontend rendering observation, external HTTPS test, or production infrastructure validation is produced by this test run.
CAPTCHA tests create a known server-side challenge fixture to test its validation; they do not evaluate resistance to OCR or CAPTCHA solving.
logSecretReview: Captured runner output checked: no password, JWT secret, access token, refresh token, or credential-bearing full database URL present.
